name: walled-sleeve
why: A ruled 2 mm sleeve through three fitted circles of radius 20, open at both ends: pi*(400-324)*40 = 9550.442 mm3 in closed form, the mesh a chord short of it. loft_wall_mm must read 2.000 at both ends, and the part has no floor: 8 faces, two ruled bands per skin and two flat rings.
